text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yukino! Happy birthday! I'm gonna whip up 
a huge, lavish feast back at the dorms, so 
you better be ready~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared one too! A special, 
extra-large birthday cake!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It was well-received in America too—no, 
it's the king, or rather, the luxurious 
queen edition!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~! Today is an outrageously lavish 
day! Thank you kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! My family sent over some 
Morioka Short-Horned Beef to celebrate! 
Hishiama-san, would you like to eat some 
together with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa... you're making even more 
food? Are you going to be alright? Won't 
you end up overeating?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it! Birthdays call for a 
mountain of delicious food, after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home, everyone in the village 
prepared mountainous feasts so we'd all be 
stuffed, and celebrated with a big party 
all night long~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Can I serve soba too? 
Some delicious ones just arrived! I want 
all of you growing girls to eat lots and 
lots!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh boy, listen to me talking like one 
of the neighborhood aunties and uncles! Is 
this what getting older feels like?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Hishi Ama-san, would it be alright if 
I gathered some people from Ritto as 
well?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, please do. Looks like we're the ones 
who need to brace ourselves...!
